original_question: In the same kernelized bandit setting with an unknown function f in an RKHS and maximal information gain gamma_N, can the standard GP-UCB algorithm, or a simple variation of it that still relies on a standard online confidence bound, achieve regret O~(sqrt(N gamma_N)) on compact domains instead of the currently derived O~(gamma_N sqrt(N)) bound?
target_in_paper: Section 4's discussion question, driven by the Section 3 Open Problem: whether a substantially tighter online RKHS confidence interval could let GP-UCB improve on the standard regret bound O~(γ_N√N) in the compact-domain kernelized bandit setting, an improvement the paper says is information-theoretically feasible but not known for GP-UCB. ([proceedings.mlr.press](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v134/vakili21a/vakili21a.pdf))
correct_elements: Your draft correctly identifies the paper's setting of kernelized bandits with an unknown reward function f in an RKHS over a compact domain, the role of maximal information gain γ_N, the standard GP-UCB regret bound R(N)=O~(γ_N√N) obtained from the known online confidence interval, and the unresolved issue of whether a much sharper GP-UCB-type regret is achievable. ([proceedings.mlr.press](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v134/vakili21a/vakili21a.pdf))

refined_question: Let X⊂R^d be compact, let k:X×X→R be a positive definite kernel with RKHS H_k, and suppose f∈H_k satisfies ||f||_{H_k}≤B. In the online kernelized bandit setting, observations are y_i=f(x_i)+ε_i, where the ε_i are i.i.d. R-sub-Gaussian and each x_{i+1} is chosen adaptively from the past. Let μ_n and σ_n be the standard regularized GP posterior mean and standard deviation (with regularization λ>0), and let γ_n be the maximal information gain. Since Theorem 2 gives the uniform online confidence bound |f(x)-μ_n(x)|≤ρ_n(δ)σ_n(x) with ρ_n(δ)=B+R√(2(γ_{n-1}+1+log(1/δ))), the standard GP-UCB analysis yields R(N)=O~(γ_N√N). Can one improve this online confidence width by an O~(√γ_n) factor, so that standard GP-UCB on compact domains achieves the paper's predicted regret O~(√(dNγ_N)) rather than O~(γ_N√N), in line with the information-theoretic feasibility suggested by the SupKernelUCB bound up to the compact-domain discretization factor? ([proceedings.mlr.press](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v134/vakili21a/vakili21a.pdf))
justification: The draft is aimed at the Section 4 consequence of the paper's formal Section 3 open problem. The paper's nearest official formulation is the question of how small the online confidence-width parameter ρ_n(δ) can be in a uniform RKHS confidence interval, specifically whether the Chowdhury-Gopalan width can be reduced by an O~(√γ_n) factor. That is the mechanism behind the regret issue, because equation (6) gives GP-UCB regret O~(ρ_N(δ)√(Nγ_N)); plugging in Theorem 2 yields O~(γ_N√N). The paper then predicts that a substantially tighter online confidence width would give O~(√(dNγ_N)) for GP-UCB, while separately noting that O~(√(Nγ_N)) is already achievable by SupKernelUCB for finite action sets and extends to compact domains with only an extra discretization factor. So the paper-faithful rewrite should foreground the confidence-interval improvement and phrase the GP-UCB regret question in exactly that narrower sense. ([proceedings.mlr.press](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v134/vakili21a/vakili21a.pdf))
